column1: #  - procedure and function are functions at any depth (a nested procedure is a named function); a routine written twice, as a header in the interface section and again with its body in the implementation, is two definitions, as in C;
#  - constructor, destructor, procedure and function inside a class, record, object or interface body are methods; a body written `procedure TShape.Draw` is a method named by its last part;
#  - class, record and object types are classes; interface types are interfaces; every other type (enumeration, alias, pointer, string, array) is a type alias;

#  - const and var at the top of a program, a unit's interface or its implementation are constants and variables, one per name; a routine's own const and var are not definitions, nor are enumeration members, parameters and calls;
#  - class, record and object fields, and properties, are fields.
